title: UNWIND_ROLE can extract proﬁt via repeated allowedUnwindSlippagePercent arbitrage
summary: This report describes a bug in the code for the LoopedSonicVault smart contract. The bug allows someone with the "UNWIND_ROLE" to repeatedly exchange LST tokens for WETH and repay the protocol with a slightly lower amount, generating profit for themselves. This can be done by taking advantage of the allowedUnwindSlippagePercent and using an external market that sells LST tokens at a higher price. The report includes a proof of concept that demonstrates the exploit.
